course_name_en: Advanced Calculations in Drying Process Materials

learning_outcomes.text: Students will learn the calculations during the drying of process materials.
Students will learn to perform computer-aided calculations in addition to applied calculations.
Students will learn calculations during the falling and constant rate periods in drying.
Students will learn calculations for combined transport, radiation, and conduction heat transfer.
Students will learn calculations for diffusion and capillary flow.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to Drying Methods and Techniques
Calculation of Adiabatic Saturation Temperatures and Wet Bulb Temperature
Vapor Pressure of Water and Humidity Tables
Calculation of Equilibrium Moisture Content for Inorganic and Biological Materials
Experimental and Algebraic Calculation of Drying Curves
Equations for Predicting Drying at Constant Rate
Calculations in the Falling Rate Period using Numerical Integral Method
Combined Transport, Radiation and Conduction Heat Transfer in the Constant Rate Period
Diffusion and Capillary Flow in the Falling Rate Period
Material and Heat Balances for Continuous Dryers
Determination of Thermal Process Time for Sterilization
bibliography: Christie John Geankoplis, Transport Processes & Separation Process Principles, Pearson
